name: Ship Gate
pass_criteria: gate.spec, gate.decisions, gate.economics, gate.trust, gate.c4, gate.build, gate.evals, gate.operate, gate.verify and gate.claims are PASS, or SKIPPED with a reason, in architecture.json
Every ADR in Accepted status names an eval that passed in the latest harness run
A ship packet lists each human gate the release would cross (publish, spend, dns, credentials) with the exact action, and no agent has crossed one
For anything priced, published or provisioned, a reviewer on a different model provider than the maker signed the claims receipt
The operator recorded the go decision with a date; an agent cannot set this gate to PASS
notes: The loop ends at this gate. Crossing it is a human act.
